description: Speaker diarization: who speaks when, in turns, with no words. Finds the number of voices by itself and handles overlapping speech. Pair it with a transcriber to give each heard word its voice. Experimental.

settings.label: Overlapping speech
settings.description: Off: one voice at a time. Where several talk at once, the turn goes to the one the model is surest of, which is what a transcript needs. On: every voice that talks gets a turn, so turns can overlap.

settings.label: Merge distance
settings.description: First grouping: how far apart two voice samples can be and still count as one voice (default 0.6). This only sets the starting voices; the final grouping can merge them but never adds more. Lower: more starting voices, which the final grouping often merges again. Higher: fewer, so voices that sound alike may be joined for good.

settings.label: Acoustic weight
settings.description: Final grouping: how much small differences in sound count (default 0.07). Higher: more voices, as small changes in one voice can be taken for another. Lower: fewer. Very sensitive; change it in steps of 0.01 to 0.05.

settings.label: Voice-count penalty
settings.description: Final grouping: the cost of each extra voice (default 0.8). Higher: fewer voices, as similar ones are merged. Lower: more. Works against Acoustic weight; very low values split one voice into many.

settings.label: Shortest voice
settings.description: How much of a 10 s stretch someone must speak alone for that stretch to shape the voices (default 0.2, 2 s). Shorter speech is still labelled, but only with a voice found elsewhere. Lower: someone who only says a few words can get a voice of their own, but voices are judged from less speech.

settings.label: At least
settings.description: The fewest voices to find. 0: no limit. Ignored when the app asks for an exact number of voices.

settings.label: At most
settings.description: The most voices to find. 0: no limit. Ignored when the app asks for an exact number of voices.
